title: Understanding the Loss Function
text:
The loss function given is a combination of the logistic loss and a regularization term. The logistic loss is used for binary classification problems and is defined as:

$$-\ln\left(y \operatorname{f_{	heta}}\left(xight)ight)-\left(1-yight) \ln\left(1-\operatorname{f_{	heta}}\left(xight)ight)$$

The regularization term is $$ rac{1}{2} {	heta}^2$$, which helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large values of theta.

title: Sigmoid Function
text:
The sigmoid function, denoted as sigma, is defined as:

$$sigma(z)= rac{1}{1+exp\left(-zight)}$$

It maps any real-valued number into the range $$(0,1)$$, making it suitable for binary classification.

title: Gradient of the Loss Function
text: To derive the stochastic gradient descent update rule, we need to compute the gradient of the loss function with respect to theta. This involves differentiating the loss function with respect to theta.

title: Compute the Gradient
text:
Differentiate the loss function with respect to theta:

$$l(theta, x, y)=-y \ln\left(\operatorname{f_{	heta}}\left(xight)ight)-\left(1-yight) \ln\left(1-\operatorname{f_{	heta}}\left(xight)ight)+ rac{1}{2} {	heta}^2$$

Find the derivative of each term with respect to theta.

title: Simplify the Gradient
text:
Simplify the expression obtained from the differentiation:

$$-y \left(1-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(	heta-2ight)ight)+\left(1-yight) \operatorname{\sigma}\left(	heta-2ight)+	heta$$

Combine like terms and simplify.

title: Update Rule
text:
Using the gradient computed, apply the stochastic gradient descent update rule:

$${	heta}^{t+1}={	heta}^t-\alpha gradient$$

Given $$alpha=1$$, substitute the gradient and simplify.

title: Final Update Rule
text:
Simplify the update rule obtained:

$${	heta}^{t+1}={	heta}^t-\operatorname{\sigma}\left({	heta}^t-2ight)-y+{	heta}^t$$

Combine like terms to get the final update rule.
